description: Migration Tools - Implement a database schema migration system that supports creating migrations (up/down SQL scripts), applying migrations, rolling back migrations, and tracking migration history in a database table.
steps: Create DBTools/Abstractions/IMigration.cs with interface: string MigrationId { get; } (timestamp-based, e.g., '20240101120000_CreateUsersTable'), string Description { get; }, string UpSql { get; }, string DownSql { get; }.

Create DBTools/Abstractions/IMigrationRunner.cs with interface: Task ApplyAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) - applies all pending migrations, Task RollbackAsync(string targetMigrationId = null, CancellationToken ct = default) - rolls back to target (or last one if null), Task<IReadOnlyList<MigrationRecord>> GetAppliedMigrationsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default), Task<IReadOnlyList<IMigration>> GetPendingMigrationsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default).
Create DBTools/Migrations/MigrationRecord.cs with: MigrationId (string), Description (string), AppliedAt (DateTime), Checksum (string - hash of UpSql to detect tampering).

Create DBTools/Migrations/MigrationBase.cs abstract class implementing IMigration: provides MigrationId/Description as abstract properties, UpSql/DownSql as abstract properties. Provides a static helper ParseTimestamp(string migrationId) to extract the datetime portion.
Create DBTools/Migrations/SqlMigration.cs - a concrete implementation that takes migrationId, description, upSql, downSql in constructor (for programmatic/inline migration creation).

Create DBTools/Migrations/MigrationRunner.cs implementing IMigrationRunner: takes IDbProvider, connectionString, and IEnumerable<IMigration> in constructor. Creates a '__DBToolsMigrations' tracking table if not exists (columns: MigrationId VARCHAR(255) PK, Description VARCHAR(500), AppliedAt DATETIME, Checksum VARCHAR(64)). ApplyAsync runs pending migrations in order within a transaction per migration. RollbackAsync runs DownSql in reverse order. Uses provider-appropriate SQL for table creation (different datetime types per provider).

Create DBTools/Migrations/MigrationOptions.cs with: MigrationTableName (string, default '__DBToolsMigrations'), IList<IMigration> Migrations (registered migrations list), AutoMigrateOnStartup (bool, default false).

Add MigrationOptions property to DbToolsOptions.cs: public MigrationOptions MigrationOptions { get; set; } = new MigrationOptions(). Add ConfigureMigrations(Action<MigrationOptions> configure) fluent method.
Register IMigrationRunner in ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddDbTools() as a scoped service using MigrationRunner, passing configured migrations.

Create DBTools/Migrations/MigrationBuilder.cs - a fluent builder to define migrations: AddMigration(string id, string description, string upSql, string downSql) returns MigrationBuilder (for use in options configuration).
Create DBToolsUnitTest/Migrations/SqlMigrationTests.cs testing migration construction and property access.

Create DBToolsUnitTest/Migrations/MigrationRunnerTests.cs testing: tracking table creation SQL generation, migration ordering, pending migration detection, checksum computation. These tests verify SQL generation logic without requiring a real database.
acceptance_criteria: IMigration and IMigrationRunner interfaces define the migration contract
MigrationRunner creates tracking table, applies migrations in order, supports rollback
Each migration runs in its own transaction for atomicity
Checksum stored to detect if migration SQL was modified after application
MigrationBuilder provides fluent API for defining migrations in configuration
DI registration integrates with existing AddDbTools pattern
Unit tests verify SQL generation, ordering, checksum logic, and builder API without requiring database connectivity
verification: Verify MigrationRunner generates valid SQL for tracking table creation per provider
Verify migration ordering uses MigrationId (timestamp-based sorting)
Verify tests follow MSTest patterns and TestBase inheritance
Verify DI registration follows existing patterns in ServiceCollectionExtensions
